tagline: Find the perfect summer camp near you
description: CampFind is a responsive single-page application that helps parents and kids find summer camps by ZIP code and age. It displays a grid of camp cards with key details, allows filtering by type, and lets users save favorites to localStorage.
target_user: Parents and families seeking summer camps for their children
core_features: ZIP code search and age slider to narrow down camps
Results grid with camp cards showing name, city, type, price, rating stars, and availability dot
Expandable card details with sessions list and contact info
Heart toggle to save favorite camps, persisted in localStorage
key_interactions: Adjust age slider to filter camps
Click on camp card to expand details
Click heart icon to toggle favorite
Click filter buttons to show Day or Overnight camps
